test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71ee1a4f3d9d848f8595721d4e265c8619a060ab386619e38625797341dad90f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first element of 2nd column and 2nd row elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbc425acdd0289c5a2961b7b303ad4463e4bebed8e182263291650c9e784c235.png] 

2) Second box series →

The corner elements of the 2nd row interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60639e612d39722781379467b410d5b7e7fe592aa90f026a4447fcbacbf8e972.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30c5d84f1676a8caec36f3d4da87dcf59c67e3e994943f51fab2be50459deed.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
